# KURIO

> KURIO is a demo NFT marketplace, a single-page app with a Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) interface. Everything in it is simulated: the API is an in-browser mock (a service worker running MSW), and there is no real backend, wallet, blockchain or payment. Nothing here can be bought, sold or transferred.

The public pages are the home page, which holds the catalog, and one details page per NFT. Account, cart, checkout and order screens exist, but they need a session and are not indexed. The data comes from the in-browser mock after the page's JavaScript runs, so the initial HTML alone does not list the NFTs.

## Public pages

- [Home and catalog](https://ntfs-marketplace.vercel.app/): highlights carousel and the NFT catalog with search, filters, sorting and pagination
- [NFT details](https://ntfs-marketplace.vercel.app/nfts/emerald-ape-042): one NFT with its gallery, price, editions and rarity; every NFT is at `/nfts/<id>`, for example `emerald-ape-042`

## Catalog URL parameters

The catalog state is kept in the home page's query string, so a filtered view is a shareable link.

- [Trending NFTs](https://ntfs-marketplace.vercel.app/?segment=trending): `segment` is `new` or `trending`
- [Cheapest first](https://ntfs-marketplace.vercel.app/?sort=price-asc): `sort` is `price-asc`, `price-desc` or `popular`
- [Search for "ape"](https://ntfs-marketplace.vercel.app/?q=ape): `q` is free text; `categories`, `networks`, `minPrice`, `maxPrice` and `page` also exist

## Machine-readable files

- [Sitemap](https://ntfs-marketplace.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): the home page
- [Agent resource catalog](https://ntfs-marketplace.vercel.app/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): intentionally lists no agents, tools or MCP servers, because the site offers none

## Optional

- [Robots rules](https://ntfs-marketplace.vercel.app/robots.txt): crawlers are welcome, except on the developer-only `/dev/` routes
